mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen from -34.6 at t-2w to -32.0 at t-0w, a two-week upward momentum; this momentum continues into the next four weeks as retail visits recover.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC=-34.6 at t-2w and -32.0 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is less than or equal to -33.3 (last 28-day mean), the retail-momentum hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GROCERY_PHARM below -12.0 indicates pantry-loading has completed and households shift trips toward retail-and-recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean when GROCERY_PHARM <= -12.0, the grocery-substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of TRANSIT above -31 and RETAIL_REC above -34 signals shared discretionary mobility; when both hold, retail visits continue recovering over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean when TRANSIT > -31.0 and RETAIL_REC > -34.0, the joint discretionary-mobility mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In mid-November, PARKS falling below -8.0 signals outdoor leisure is losing appeal; households substitute indoor retail-and-recreation trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean when PARKS < -8.0, the indoor-substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rising above 9.0 indicates a stay-at-home drift; this reduces discretionary retail trips, so RETAIL_REC declines over the next week.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is not lower than last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL > 9.0, the stay-at-home suppression hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in PARKS and TRANSIT relative to t-1w indicates tightening out-of-home activity; this drags discretionary retail visits down over the next week.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is not lower than last 28-day mean when PARKS < -8.0 and TRANSIT < -30.0, the tightening-interaction hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has been flat near -30 for four weeks and shows no reopening impulse; without transit recovery, discretionary retail trips remain constrained, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT=-30.0 at t-3w and -30.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean while TRANSIT stays between -31 and -29, the transit-constraint hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES is above -36 and RETAIL_REC is above -33, commuting and retail demand reinforce each other; this demand-led regime lifts RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is not higher than last 28-day mean when WORKPLACES > -36.0 and RETAIL_REC > -33.0, the demand-led interaction hypothesis is rejected.
